name: Youxing Kong
identity: AI for Science in Complex Geotechnical and Geohazard Systems | Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing
overview: Research focuses on AI for science in complex geotechnical and geohazard systems: inferring system states from sparse, heterogeneous, multiscale observations; combining physical laws and domain knowledge to learn evolutionary mechanisms; and advancing failure prediction, uncertainty analysis, and reliable engineering decision-making.
Research pathway: Observation → Understanding → Prediction → Decision-making | Approach: Field engineering × Geotechnical mechanics and testing × AI for science

entries.title: PhD Student in Geological Engineering — Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
paragraphs: • Research focuses on AI for science in complex geotechnical and geohazard systems, including spatiotemporal learning, physics- and knowledge-guided modelling, long-term deformation forecasting, and failure prediction.

entries.title: Master of Engineering in Geological Engineering — Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
paragraphs: GPA: 3.66 | Thesis: Mechanisms of landslide initiation in fissured expansive soils

• Investigated fissure propagation and slope failure in expansive soils through fracture mechanics tests, digital image correlation (DIC), electrical resistivity monitoring, microstructural characterisation, slope model tests, and field-based landslide mechanism analysis.

entries.title: Bachelor of Engineering in Civil Engineering — China University of Geosciences (Beijing)
paragraphs: GPA: 3.68 | Class rank: 2/78 (top 3%)

entries.title: Engineer (Intermediate Professional Title), Beijing Urban Construction Exploration & Surveying Design Research Institute Co., Ltd.
paragraphs: • Conduct safety monitoring, intelligent inspection, and research for urban infrastructure, including mobile scanning and surface defect inspection of metro tunnels, structural monitoring, and municipal utility surveys.

• Apply image recognition, generative image processing, and time-series forecasting to engineering monitoring data; contribute to research papers, technical reports, and AI-related research proposals.

entries.title: Entrepreneurship, Kulianggong Studio
paragraphs: • Co-founded and operate an AI-driven research and knowledge studio, exploring generative AI applications in research support, data analysis, research communication, and knowledge management.
• Design end-to-end processes from task analysis and AI workflow development to deliverable production, exploring lean, AI-enhanced knowledge services and professional workflows.

entries.title: Key Participant, National Key R&D Program of China: New Materials and Technologies for the Prevention and Control of Expansive-Soil Landslides and Engineered Slopes (2019YFC1509903)
paragraphs: • Investigate the hydro-mechanical behaviour of expansive soils, slope failure mechanisms, and engineering mitigation techniques, with emphasis on the effects of moisture variation and soil strength degradation on slope stability.

entries.title: Key Participant, Second Tibetan Plateau Scientific Expedition and Research Program: Geohazards and Risks Associated with Major Engineering Disturbances in the South Asia Corridor–Himalayas–River and Lake Headwater Regions (2019QZKK0904)
paragraphs: • Investigate the occurrence, spatial variability, and risk formation mechanisms of geohazards along major engineering corridors on the Tibetan Plateau; explore geohazard investigation and risk assessment methods for complex mountainous terrain.

entries.title: Key Participant, National Natural Science Foundation of China: Microscale Controls on Shallow Landslides in Multiscale Fissured Expansive Soils (42572368)
paragraphs: • Investigate microstructural evolution, fissure development, and multiscale hydro-mechanical coupling in expansive soils under wetting–drying cycles to elucidate the microscale controls on shallow landslides.

entries.title: Participant, National Natural Science Foundation of China: Investigation of the In-Service Structural Performance of Metro Shield Tunnels Using Large-Scale Data (52378385)
paragraphs: • Investigate the evolution of in-service structural conditions, surface defect characteristics, and recognition reliability in shield tunnels, focusing on structural safety assessment under complex environmental conditions.

entries.title: Participant, National Key R&D Program of China: Integrated Slope Protection and Ecological Restoration in Areas Disturbed by Major Hydropower Projects in the Upper Reaches of Southwestern China’s Rivers (2024YFF1307800)
paragraphs: • Investigate slope deformation and failure mechanisms, geohazard risk evolution, and the interaction between engineering protection and ecological restoration under disturbances caused by major hydropower projects.

entries.title: Shandong Institute of Geophysical and Geochemical Exploration — Atmospheric Deposition Monitoring and Analysis
paragraphs: • Participated in field monitoring, sampling, and analysis of atmospheric deposition, gaining experience in environmental geochemical surveys, sample quality control, and field data acquisition.

entries.title: Chuxiong, Yunnan — MICP-Based Ecological Slope Stabilisation Demonstration
paragraphs: • Participated in a demonstration of phosphogypsum utilisation and ecological slope stabilisation using microbially induced calcium carbonate precipitation (MICP), including microbial cultivation, material mixing, mechanised spraying, planting, and site construction.

entries.title: Yelu Expressway, Henan — Coal Gangue as Subgrade Fill
paragraphs: • Conducted compaction, vibratory compaction, and California bearing ratio (CBR) tests on coal gangue with different particle sizes and gradations; assessed its suitability as subgrade fill using a trial road section.

entries.title: Zhangjiawan Depot — Unloading Monitoring of a Large-Span Steel Dome
paragraphs: • Participated in strain sensor installation on critical members, continuous stress and temperature monitoring, and data analysis to support safety control during staged unloading of a large-span steel dome.

entries.title: Beijing Metro — Fire-Door Inspection and Surveying of Tunnel Cross-Passages
paragraphs: • Participated in fire-door inspection, engineering surveying, and condition data collection for tunnel cross-passages during maintenance windows and night shifts, gaining experience in field coordination and inspection in complex underground environments.

entries.title: AI-Augmented Development
paragraphs: Codex, ChatGPT, and other AI development tools; AI-assisted programming, research workflow automation, data engineering, and scientific computing; Python, C++, MATLAB, GIS, and numerical simulation software.

entries.title: AI for Science
paragraphs: AI research workflow design and automation; research agents and multimodal large models; knowledge augmentation and intelligent reasoning; computer vision and generative AI; spatiotemporal intelligence and geospatial machine learning; physics-informed machine learning; digital soil mapping.

entries.title: Geotechnical Engineering
paragraphs: Engineering geological investigation, geohazard assessment, slope stability analysis, geotechnical laboratory testing, microstructural characterisation (XRD, SEM/EDS, MIP, BET), three-dimensional laser scanning, and engineering monitoring (GNSS, DIC).
• Authored 20 popular-science articles on engineering geology for official Chinese Academy of Sciences platforms, attracting more than 200,000 cumulative reads.
Languages: Chinese (native); English: IELTS 7.5 (Listening 8.5 / Reading 7.5 / Writing 7.0 / Speaking 6.5).
